integrity: The universal coefficient is proved from Gaussian section integration and the \(O(n)\)-invariant second moment of a Haar rank-\(m\) projection; the bundled checker only verifies the algebraic contractions and factorization.
scientific_limitations: Local second-order statement on centered determinant-one Gaussian precision matrices; no global extremality claim and no higher-order claim at \(q=n\).
title: Gaussian anisotropy has a sharp \(q=n\) centro-sectional phase transition
